html: Hi, if you look at the example, it runs on a new method for distributing and executing cloud applications—one that is much more secure, cost-effective, and high-performing. It uses Nanos unikernel… you can see the benefits here: https://foojay.io/today/java-jakarta-ee-and-the-evolution-of-the-cloud-with-nanos-unikernel/
